objective: B311, G15 with G16. Freeze a learner in which each rewarded image adds one parity knot over memory distinctions and an image is answered only when the knots force it; score it on fresh blind letter drawings beside the recorded count reader; then add distinctions when the examples contradict each other. Stop at right, wrong and unanswered counts by letter and turn under both laws.
status: Computed, referee pending. On 32 fresh letter designs a learner whose rewarded examples are parity knots gave no wrong answer on trained designs at held turns but answered 8 of 64; on designs never trained it was wrong on 104 of 240 answers against 72 of the same 240 for the recorded count reader. Varied training and shuffled labels leave its memory with no allowed word (K3 fails), a sign the count reader lacks; adding window families until a word is allowed answered 0 of 768 held images. The not-all-equal version answers nothing by construction.
title: A learner whose examples are knots
